boards.title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain Assumption University
boards.description: A guide to the essential late-night food destinations for Assumption University students, featuring on-campus staples and local Worcester favorites open after hours.

cards.title: Charlie's Snack Bar
cards.subtitle: The Primary On-Campus Late-Night Hub
cards.notes: Visit the Hagan Campus Center for made-to-order meals and grab-and-go options available until midnight on weekdays.
cards.short_summary: Located in the Hagan Campus Center, Charlie's is the go-to retail dining spot for Assumption students seeking late-night fuel.
cards.evidence_claim: Charlie's is open 11 a.m. to midnight Monday through Friday, offering made-to-order and grab-and-go meals.
cards.access_notes: Open until midnight Monday-Friday; check university dining portal for weekend variations.

cards.title: Taylor Dining Hall
cards.subtitle: All-You-Care-To-Eat Evening Dining
cards.notes: Head to the newly renovated main dining hall for a variety of food concepts and comfort favorites until 8 p.m. most nights.
cards.short_summary: The primary resident dining facility on campus, Taylor Dining Hall provides continuous service throughout the day and early evening.
cards.evidence_claim: Taylor Dining Hall offers continuous dining from 7:45 a.m. to 8 p.m. Monday through Thursday.
cards.access_notes: Open until 8 p.m. Monday-Thursday and 7 p.m. on Fridays.

cards.title: Boulevard Diner
cards.subtitle: A 24-Hour Worcester Institution
cards.notes: Drive to Shrewsbury Street for classic diner fare at this historic 1936 lunch car, open 24 hours from Thursday to Sunday.
cards.short_summary: A historic Worcester landmark, the Boulevard Diner serves hearty portions of breakfast and comfort food around the clock on weekends.
cards.evidence_claim: The Boulevard Diner is open 24 hours from Thursday through Sunday, and until 11 p.m. Monday through Wednesday.
cards.access_notes: Open 24 hours Thursday-Sunday; closes at 10:45 p.m. Monday-Wednesday.

cards.title: Antonio's Pizza By The Slice
cards.subtitle: Late-Night Slices on Chandler Street
cards.notes: Order creative pizza slices like Chicken Bacon Ranch until midnight on weekends at this popular Chandler Street spot.
cards.short_summary: Known for its diverse and unique pizza toppings, Antonio's serves the Worcester community late into the night.
cards.evidence_claim: Antonio's Pizza By The Slice in Worcester is open until midnight on Thursday, Friday, and Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Open until midnight Thursday-Saturday; 10 p.m. other nights.

cards.title: Insomnia Cookies
cards.subtitle: Warm Cookie Delivery Until 1 AM
cards.notes: Satisfy your sweet tooth with warm cookies delivered to campus or picked up in Kelley Square until 1 a.m. most nights.
cards.short_summary: A staple for college students nationwide, Insomnia Cookies in Worcester provides late-night dessert delivery and pickup.
cards.evidence_claim: Insomnia Cookies in Worcester offers pickup and delivery until approximately 12:35 a.m. or 1 a.m. daily.
cards.access_notes: Open for late-night delivery and pickup until 1 a.m. daily.

cards.title: Wings Over Worcester
cards.subtitle: Late-Night Chicken Wings and Tenders
cards.notes: Order boneless wings and tenders for pickup or delivery from Kelley Square until 11 p.m. daily.
cards.short_summary: Wings Over is a popular choice for students looking for late-night protein, offering a wide range of sauces and dry rubs.
cards.evidence_claim: Wings Over Worcester is open from 4:00 PM to 11:00 PM daily.
cards.source_title: Order Chicken | Wings Over - MA - Worcester
cards.access_notes: Open until 11 p.m. every night for pickup and delivery.

cards.title: The Fix Burger Bar
cards.subtitle: Custom Burgers on Grove Street
cards.notes: Enjoy a custom-built burger or a signature 'Fixed-Up' burger at this Grove Street spot, open until 10 p.m. or later.
cards.short_summary: The Fix offers a high-quality burger experience with dozens of toppings and house-made sodas in a lively atmosphere.
cards.evidence_claim: The Fix Burger Bar in Worcester is open daily, with online ordering available until 9:10 p.m. and dine-in later.
cards.access_notes: Open daily; typically closes at 10 p.m. or 11 p.m. depending on the day.

cards.title: Tech Pizza
cards.subtitle: Highland Street Student Favorite
cards.notes: Stop by Highland Street for pizza, grinders, and salads, with free delivery available after 6 p.m. until midnight.
cards.short_summary: A long-standing favorite near the local colleges, Tech Pizza is known for its consistent quality and late-night delivery.
cards.evidence_claim: Tech Pizza offers free delivery from 6:00 p.m. to midnight.
cards.access_notes: Delivery available until midnight; storefront hours may vary.

cards.title: The Boynton
cards.subtitle: Late-Night Menu Near WPI
cards.notes: Visit this Worcester staple for a dedicated late-night menu featuring discounted wings on Thursday, Friday, and Saturday.
cards.short_summary: The Boynton is a classic American restaurant that serves a popular late-night menu to the local student population.
cards.evidence_claim: The Boynton offers a late-night menu on Thursday from 9 p.m. to close and Friday-Saturday from 10 p.m. to close.
cards.access_notes: Late-night menu available Thursday-Saturday; under-21 safe for dining.

cards.title: Hagan Café
cards.subtitle: Coffee and Pastries in the Campus Center
cards.notes: Grab a Caribou Coffee or a freshly baked pastry at this campus center cafe, typically open for morning and early afternoon needs.
cards.short_summary: Replacing the former Dunkin', the Hagan Café serves as a central social and caffeine hub for students in the Hagan Campus Center.
cards.evidence_claim: The Hagan Café serves Caribou Coffee and freshly baked pastries and is located in the Hagan Campus Center.
cards.source_title: Assumption Introduces New Café on Campus
cards.access_notes: Typically open until 2 p.m.; check campus dining for extended seasonal hours.

boards.title: What the Campus Tour Skips: 10 Places Students Share With Each Other
boards.description: Discover the functional student spaces and quiet corners of Assumption University that define daily life beyond the standard admissions route.

cards.title: Emmanuel d'Alzon Library Study Rooms
cards.subtitle: Quiet group collaboration zones
cards.notes: Book one of the nine reservable rooms for up to two hours via the library's online LibCal system for focused group projects.
cards.short_summary: Reservable group study rooms located on the first and third floors of the central campus library.
cards.evidence_claim: The library offers six study rooms on the first floor and three on the third floor, reservable for 2 hours per day.
cards.source_title: How do I reserve a study room - d'Alzon Library Answers
cards.access_notes: Open during library hours; reservations can be made up to two weeks in advance using a student login.

cards.title: Charlie's Snack Bar
cards.subtitle: Late-night social hub in Hagan
cards.notes: Grab made-to-order meals or use GrubHub mobile ordering to skip the line at this popular student hangout in the Hagan Campus Center.
cards.short_summary: A retail dining location in the Hagan Campus Center offering a variety of quick-service meals and social space.
cards.evidence_claim: Charlie's is located in the Hagan Campus Center and offers made-to-order and grab-and-go meals.
cards.access_notes: Open for lunch and dinner; specific hours vary by semester and are posted on the dining website.

cards.title: Testa Science Center Atrium
cards.subtitle: Sunlit study spot with historic glass
cards.notes: Study under the towering windows featuring stained glass salvaged from the original campus buildings destroyed in a 1953 tornado.
cards.short_summary: A bright, multi-story atrium in the science building used by students for quiet study between lab sessions.
cards.evidence_claim: Testa Science Center boasts a stunning atrium on the first floor with historic stained glass windows.
cards.access_notes: Accessible during academic building hours, typically 7 AM to 11 PM.

cards.title: Alumni Hall Commuter Lounge
cards.subtitle: Home base for non-resident students
cards.notes: Utilize the kitchen, lockers, and soft seating in this newly renovated space designed specifically for commuter student needs.
cards.short_summary: A dedicated lounge in Alumni Hall providing amenities and a relaxation area for students living off-campus.
cards.evidence_claim: Alumni Hall is home to a brand new common room which serves as the commuter lounge with a kitchen and lockers.
cards.access_notes: Primarily for commuter students; accessible via student ID card.

cards.title: Tinsley Interfaith Prayer Room
cards.subtitle: Quiet reflection in Tinsley Center
cards.notes: Visit this peaceful room for silent meditation or prayer, available to students of all faith traditions from early morning until late night.
cards.short_summary: A dedicated quiet space for prayer and reflection located within the Tinsley Campus Ministry Center.
cards.evidence_claim: The Interfaith Prayer Room in the Tinsley Campus Ministry Center is available for quiet prayer from 6 AM to 11 PM.
cards.source_title: Prayer and Worship on Campus - Assumption University
cards.access_notes: Open daily from 6 AM to 11 PM for all students.

cards.title: Plourde Recreation Center Indoor Track
cards.subtitle: Elevated running path
cards.notes: Run or walk on the elevated track overlooking the basketball courts to stay active regardless of the New England weather.
cards.short_summary: An elevated indoor running track located on the upper level of the Plourde Recreation Center.
cards.evidence_claim: The Plourde Recreation Center includes an elevated track among its fitness facilities.
cards.source_title: Plourde Recreation Center - Assumption University Athletics
cards.access_notes: Open during Plourde Recreation Center hours; requires student ID for entry.

cards.title: Hagan Esports Lounge
cards.subtitle: Competitive and casual gaming hub
cards.notes: Join the gaming community in Hagan to play casually or compete in organized esports tournaments with fellow students.
cards.short_summary: A dedicated gaming facility in the Hagan Campus Center equipped for both casual play and competitive esports.
cards.evidence_claim: The esports lounge in Hagan Campus Center offers opportunities for students to relax and play games.
cards.access_notes: Accessible to all students during Campus Center operating hours.

cards.title: La Maison Salon
cards.subtitle: Formal gathering space
cards.notes: Attend academic lectures or formal university receptions in this traditional hall located in the campus's original Salisbury Street building.
cards.short_summary: A large, formal gathering space located within La Maison Française, used for various university events.
cards.evidence_claim: La Maison Salon and La Maison Hall are two large gathering spaces on each side of the main entrance of La Maison Française.
cards.access_notes: Open for scheduled events and general student access during administrative hours.

cards.title: D'Amore Plaza
cards.subtitle: Outdoor study and social terrace
cards.notes: Take advantage of the outdoor seating outside the Tsotsis Family Academic Center for group study or fresh air between classes.
cards.short_summary: A landscaped outdoor plaza with seating located adjacent to the Tsotsis Family Academic Center.
cards.evidence_claim: D'Amore Plaza features an array of seating options for students to relax, chat, or study outdoors.
cards.source_title: Take a virtual campus tour and explore Assumption University
cards.access_notes: Publicly accessible outdoor space on campus.

cards.title: Laska Gymnasium Hound Pound
cards.subtitle: The student cheering section
cards.notes: Join the 'Hound Pound' during home basketball games to experience the high-energy atmosphere that gives the Greyhounds a home-court advantage.
cards.short_summary: The dedicated student section within Laska Gymnasium, known for its electric atmosphere during athletic events.
cards.evidence_claim: Laska is known for its electric atmosphere, highlighted by the Greyhound 'Hound Pound' student section.
cards.source_title: Andrew Laska Gymnasium - Assumption University Athletics
cards.access_notes: Accessible during home games; students typically receive free admission with ID.

boards.title: Zero Dollars: 10 Hangs That Cost Nothing
boards.description: Discover free social spaces and activities at Assumption University, from scenic outdoor spots to student-centric indoor hubs.

cards.title: Relax by the Duck Pond
cards.subtitle: Outdoor nature spot near the main gates
cards.notes: Visit the campus duck pond to relax or study outdoors; it is a popular spot for students to take in nature during warmer months.
cards.short_summary: A scenic outdoor area near the campus entrance ideal for relaxation and nature watching.
cards.evidence_claim: The duck pond and the surrounding area are a popular place for students to relax, study and take in nature.
cards.source_title: Take a virtual campus tour and explore Assumption University
cards.access_notes: Open to the campus community during daylight hours.

cards.title: Socialize in the Campus Hub
cards.subtitle: Central student activity center
cards.notes: Hang out with friends in the large common areas of the Hagan Campus Center, which serves as the heartbeat of student life.
cards.short_summary: The primary indoor social hub for students featuring common areas and student organization offices.
cards.evidence_claim: Hagan Campus Center is the heartbeat of student life. Hang out with friends in large common areas.
cards.access_notes: Open daily; hours typically extend late for student use.

cards.title: Shoot Hoops at the Plourde
cards.subtitle: Multi-purpose recreation facility
cards.notes: Access three basketball courts for open recreation; the facility is free for the Assumption community to stay active.
cards.short_summary: A 63,000 square foot facility offering basketball courts, a pool, and fitness equipment for student use.
cards.evidence_claim: The Plourde offers students year-round access to an advanced recreation center complete with... three basketball courts.
cards.access_notes: Open Mon-Wed until 10 PM, Thu-Fri until 9 PM, and weekends.

cards.title: Study in the d'Alzon Library
cards.subtitle: Academic research and study space
cards.notes: Utilize group study rooms or quiet floors for collaborative work; students have after-hours access to the first floor.
cards.short_summary: The university's main library providing diverse study environments and research resources.
cards.evidence_claim: Student after-hours access to the first floor of the Library 7 days a week when Fall/Spring classes in session.
cards.access_notes: First floor accessible Sun-Thu until 12 AM with student ID.

cards.title: Visit the Testa Atrium
cards.subtitle: Sunlit space with historic stained glass
cards.notes: Admire the towering windows and stained glass in this sunlit atrium, which serves as a quiet spot for students between classes.
cards.short_summary: A prominent architectural space in the science center featuring historic stained glass and natural light.
cards.evidence_claim: Testa also boasts a stunning atrium on the first floor... home to various annual events.
cards.access_notes: Accessible during academic building hours.

cards.title: Lounge at D'Amore Plaza
cards.subtitle: Outdoor seating near Tsotsis Center
cards.notes: Use the array of seating options to relax or chat with friends in this outdoor plaza located just outside the Tsotsis building.
cards.short_summary: An outdoor gathering space with seating designed for student relaxation and social interaction.
cards.evidence_claim: Just outside of Tsotsis is the D'Amore Plaza, which features an array of seating options for students to relax.
cards.source_title: Take a virtual campus tour and explore Assumption University
cards.access_notes: Open 24/7 as an outdoor campus space.

cards.title: Reflect at the Holy Spirit Chapel
cards.subtitle: Iconic campus spiritual center
cards.notes: Visit for quiet reflection or attend a student-led liturgy; the chapel is a vibrant community space for all students.
cards.short_summary: The university's central spiritual building, known for its architecture and inclusive community.
cards.evidence_claim: The Chapel of the Holy Spirit is a vibrant spiritual community for students who are Catholic, follow other religious, or non-religious.
cards.source_title: Prayer and Worship on Campus - Assumption University
cards.access_notes: Open daily for prayer and scheduled services.

cards.title: Relax in the Alumni Lounge
cards.subtitle: Commuter and student common room
cards.notes: Enjoy soft seating, a television, and kitchen facilities in this newly renovated lounge located within Alumni Hall.
cards.short_summary: A comfortable indoor lounge space specifically designed for commuters and residential students to relax.
cards.evidence_claim: Alumni is also home to a brand new common room, which also serves as the commuter lounge.
cards.access_notes: Accessible to students with ID card entry.

cards.title: Walk the Indoor Track
cards.subtitle: Elevated track in the recreation center
cards.notes: Walk or run on the elevated indoor track at the Plourde Center, available for free to all students year-round.
cards.short_summary: An elevated indoor walking and running track providing a climate-controlled exercise option.
cards.evidence_claim: The Plourde offers students year-round access to... an indoor track.
cards.access_notes: Available during regular Plourde Recreation Center hours.

cards.title: Explore the Activities Fair
cards.subtitle: Annual campus involvement event
cards.notes: Attend the annual fair on the quad to learn about over 60 student organizations and find free ways to get involved.
cards.short_summary: A major campus event where students can discover and join various clubs and organizations for free.
cards.evidence_claim: The Office of Student Activities hosted the annual Assumption University Clubs and Activities Fair outside on the quad space.
cards.source_title: Students Get Involved at Assumption University's 2022 Clubs and Activities Fair
cards.access_notes: Held annually in early September on the campus quad.

boards.title: Claimed by 9am: 10 Study Spots Worth Showing Up Early For
boards.description: From high-tech trading rooms to quiet library alcoves, these are the most reliable study environments on Assumption University's Worcester campus.

cards.title: First Floor Group Study Rooms
cards.subtitle: Emmanuel d'Alzon Library
cards.notes: Reserve one of six group rooms on the first floor for up to two hours. These spaces feature large tables and whiteboards for collaborative projects.
cards.short_summary: The library's primary collaborative hub featuring six reservable group study rooms on the first floor.
cards.evidence_claim: Six study rooms are available on the first floor and can be reserved for 2 hours per day up to 2 weeks in advance.
cards.source_title: How do I reserve a study room - d'Alzon Library Answers
cards.access_notes: Open to current students; after-hours access to the first floor is available via ID card scan until midnight Sunday-Thursday.

cards.title: Honors Lounge and Study Suite
cards.subtitle: Tsotsis Family Academic Center
cards.notes: Access private study rooms and a computer lounge within this multi-functional suite. Complimentary coffee and tea are often available for the honors community.
cards.short_summary: A dedicated academic suite in the Tsotsis Center offering private study rooms and a social lounge.
cards.evidence_claim: The Honors suite includes several study rooms, a computer lounge, and spaces for private studying in the Tsotsis Family Academic Center.
cards.source_title: Honors: Lounge and Study Suite - Assumption University
cards.access_notes: Primary access for members of the Honors community; features whiteboards and conference space.

cards.title: Health Sciences Break-out Rooms
cards.subtitle: Richard J. & Sophia Catrambone Health Sciences Center
cards.notes: Utilize modern breakout rooms and lounges designed for collaborative work. These spaces are located near the nursing simulation suites.
cards.short_summary: Modern collaborative study rooms located within the university's newest health sciences facility.
cards.evidence_claim: The 41,000 square-foot building features lounges, break-out study rooms, and conference rooms throughout the facility.
cards.access_notes: Open during building hours; designed to facilitate active learning and group debriefing.

cards.title: Testa Science Center Atrium
cards.subtitle: Testa Science Center
cards.notes: Study under the light of towering windows and historic stained glass. This sunlit atrium provides a spacious environment for individual work.
cards.short_summary: A bright, open-air study environment featuring historic stained glass and a three-story glass atrium.
cards.evidence_claim: The Testa Science Center features a sunlit Atrium with towering windows and stained glass originally from the preparatory school.
cards.source_title: Testa Science Center Atrium - Worcester - Assumption University
cards.access_notes: Publicly accessible during academic building hours; often used for campus events but available for study between sessions.

cards.title: Alumni Hall Commuter Lounge
cards.subtitle: Alumni Hall Basement
cards.notes: Take advantage of the soft seating and kitchen facilities in this recently renovated lounge. It includes a conference room for group meetings.
cards.short_summary: A renovated basement lounge in Alumni Hall equipped with a kitchen and conference space for commuters and residents.
cards.evidence_claim: The newly renovated Alumni Hall Lounge features a kitchen, conference room, soft seating with television, and lockers.
cards.access_notes: Located in the basement of Alumni Hall; open to all students including commuters.

cards.title: Hagan Center Common Areas
cards.subtitle: Hagan Campus Center
cards.notes: Find a spot in the large common areas of the campus hub. It's ideal for casual study sessions near Charlie's Snack Bar and Dunkin'.
cards.short_summary: The central student hub offering large common areas for social studying and quick access to dining.
cards.evidence_claim: Hagan Campus Center serves as the hub for students with large common areas to hang out and study.
cards.access_notes: Open late; Charlie's Snack Bar within the building is open until midnight Monday through Friday.

cards.title: Tinsley Center Library
cards.subtitle: Tinsley Campus Ministry Center
cards.notes: Browse theological and spiritual materials in this quiet library. The center also features a conference room and an interfaith prayer room.
cards.short_summary: A quiet library and conference space located within the Tinsley Campus Ministry Center.
cards.evidence_claim: The Tinsley Campus Ministry Center is home to a conference room and a library with theological and spiritual reading materials.
cards.access_notes: The interfaith prayer room is open 6 AM to 11 PM daily; the library is accessible during center hours.

cards.title: La Maison Salon
cards.subtitle: La Maison Française
cards.notes: Study in one of the original buildings on campus. The Salon and Hall serve as large gathering spaces near the main entrance.
cards.short_summary: A historic gathering space in the university's original Salisbury Street building.
cards.evidence_claim: Two large gathering spaces, La Maison Salon and La Maison Hall, greet you on each side of the main entrance.
cards.access_notes: Primarily houses administrative offices; the Salon is available for study when not reserved for official functions.

cards.title: Third Floor Quiet Study Rooms
cards.subtitle: Emmanuel d'Alzon Library
cards.notes: Head to the third floor for a more secluded study environment. Three additional reservable rooms are available for focused work.
cards.short_summary: Secluded study rooms on the library's third floor for quiet, individual or small group work.
cards.evidence_claim: Three additional study rooms are available on the third floor of the d'Alzon Library.
cards.source_title: How do I reserve a study room - d'Alzon Library Answers
cards.access_notes: Reservations follow the same 2-hour limit as first-floor rooms; typically quieter than the main level.

cards.title: TFAC Common Study Spaces
cards.subtitle: Tsotsis Family Academic Center
cards.notes: Find a seat in the open common areas of this 62,000 square-foot facility. These spots are perfect for studying between classes in the Grenon School of Business.
cards.short_summary: Open-access study areas distributed throughout the Tsotsis Family Academic Center.
cards.evidence_claim: The Tsotsis Family Academic Center features common study spaces and seminar rooms throughout the building.
cards.access_notes: Open during academic building hours; features high-tech flexible environments.

boards.title: 10 Blocks Off Campus, One Reason Each

cards.title: The Campus Gateway
cards.subtitle: Salisbury Street Corridor
cards.notes: Walk south from the main entrance to reach the Worcester Art Museum and historic residential architecture lining this primary campus artery.

cards.evidence_claim: Assumption University is located at 500 Salisbury Street, which serves as the main access road for the campus.

cards.evidence_claim: The Fix Burger Bar at 108 Grove St is highlighted as a creative dining destination for the campus community.

cards.title: Retail & Essentials
cards.subtitle: Gold Star Boulevard Corridor

cards.title: Restaurant Row

cards.short_summary: Worcester's premier dining destination, famous for its Italian heritage and diverse restaurant selection.
cards.evidence_claim: Shrewsbury Street is known as 'Restaurant Row' and is a recommended destination for Assumption students.
cards.access_notes: Public street; Root & Press is located at 156 Shrewsbury Street.

cards.title: The Healthy Choice

cards.notes: Visit Nu Kitchen for healthy lifestyle eats or Nancy Chang's for fresh Asian cuisine, both located along this busy transit route.
cards.short_summary: A key east-west corridor connecting several campus communities with a focus on health-conscious dining.
cards.evidence_claim: Nu Kitchen and Nancy Chang's on Chandler Street are listed as favorite student eateries.

cards.title: Historic Student Living

cards.notes: Walk through this neighborhood known for its high concentration of historic homes and student-friendly residential environment.

boards.title: Only Happens Here: 10 Traditions That Make No Sense Anywhere Else
boards.description: From the ceremonial return of campus ducks to the midnight serving of breakfast by professors, these traditions define the Greyhound spirit at Assumption University.

cards.title: Duck Day
cards.subtitle: The Official Arrival of Spring
cards.notes: Watch the ceremonial red carpet procession as campus ducks return to the pond after wintering on a local farm. Includes a blessing and student-named ducks.
cards.short_summary: An annual spring tradition where the university's ducks are ceremoniously released back into the campus pond.
cards.evidence_claim: Duck Day began in 1984 and became an official university event in 2004, featuring a red carpet procession and a blessing of the ducks.
cards.access_notes: Held annually in April at the Duck Pond near the campus entrance; open to the public.

cards.title: Midnight Breakfast
cards.subtitle: Faculty-Served Finals Fuel
cards.notes: Head to Taylor Dining Hall on the last day of classes to be served breakfast by university faculty and staff as a send-off for final exams.
cards.short_summary: A late-night meal served by faculty and staff to students on the final day of the semester.
cards.evidence_claim: Midnight Breakfast occurs on the last day of classes with faculty and staff volunteering to serve breakfast favorites to students.
cards.access_notes: Takes place late at night in Taylor Dining Hall on the last day of the fall and spring semesters.

cards.title: Taylor Thanksgiving
cards.subtitle: The Pre-Break Community Feast
cards.notes: Join the long line at Taylor Dining Hall for a full Thanksgiving spread shared by students, faculty, and staff before the holiday break.
cards.short_summary: A massive community Thanksgiving dinner held in the campus dining hall before students depart for break.
cards.evidence_claim: Taylor Thanksgiving is a fall classic where the entire community gathers for a feast in Taylor Dining Hall.
cards.access_notes: Held annually in November; students typically line up early for the event.

cards.title: Pup Cup
cards.subtitle: Underclassmen Class Rivalry
cards.notes: Cheer on the first-year and sophomore classes as they compete in field games and challenges during Spring Weekend to win the trophy.
cards.short_summary: A competitive field day event between freshmen and sophomores held during the annual Spring Weekend.
cards.evidence_claim: The Pup Cup is held annually during Spring Weekend where first-year and sophomore classes compete for the Pup Cup Trophy.
cards.access_notes: Outdoor event held on campus fields during the spring semester.

cards.title: Blessing of the Hands
cards.subtitle: Nursing Clinical Induction
cards.notes: Attend this ceremony in the Chapel of the Holy Spirit where nursing students' hands are anointed with oil before they begin clinical rotations.
cards.short_summary: A spiritual ceremony for nursing students marking the transition to clinical practice.
cards.evidence_claim: The Froelich School of Nursing holds an annual Blessing of the Hands ceremony in the Chapel of the Holy Spirit.
cards.source_title: Blessing of the Hands 2025 - Assumption University
cards.access_notes: Held in the Chapel of the Holy Spirit; primarily for nursing students and their families.

cards.title: Festival of Lessons and Carols
cards.subtitle: Advent Musical Tradition
cards.notes: Experience a service of scripture readings and choral music in the Chapel of the Holy Spirit, a cherished holiday tradition since the 19th century.
cards.short_summary: A traditional Advent service featuring choral performances and biblical readings.
cards.evidence_claim: The Festival of Lessons and Carols is one of the university's most cherished holiday traditions, held annually in December.
cards.source_title: Festival of Lessons and Carols - Assumption University
cards.access_notes: Open to the public; held in the Chapel of the Holy Spirit during the first week of December.

cards.title: Christmas in Charlie's
cards.subtitle: Last Day of Classes Celebration
cards.notes: Visit the Hagan Campus Center to see Charlie's transformed into a winter wonderland with cookie decorating, eggnog, and ornament crafting.
cards.short_summary: A festive holiday celebration held in the campus snack bar on the final day of fall classes.
cards.evidence_claim: Christmas in Charlie's is an annual event where the snack bar is transformed with crafts, food, and giveaways to celebrate the end of classes.
cards.source_title: Celebrating the Christmas Season at Assumption
cards.access_notes: Located in the Hagan Campus Center; held during the day on the last Wednesday of fall classes.

cards.title: Tickets-for-Tots
cards.subtitle: Parking Fine Forgiveness
cards.notes: Exchange a new toy donation for the forgiveness of an on-campus parking citation during this annual holiday drive run by Public Safety.
cards.short_summary: A unique program where parking tickets are cleared in exchange for charitable toy donations.
cards.evidence_claim: The Department of Public Safety holds an annual Tickets-for-Tots program where parking citations are forgiven for a toy donation.
cards.source_title: Celebrating the Christmas Season at Assumption
cards.access_notes: Donations are typically collected in the Hagan Campus Center during early December.

cards.title: Founders Week
cards.subtitle: Celebrating the Augustinians
cards.notes: Participate in a week of events, including the Mass of the Holy Spirit and a gear swap, to honor the university's 1904 founding by the Assumptionists.
cards.short_summary: A week-long series of events at the start of the academic year celebrating the school's history and mission.
cards.evidence_claim: Founders Week is an annual celebration observed at the beginning of each academic year to celebrate the university's founders.
cards.access_notes: Events take place across campus during the first full week of September.

cards.title: Winterfest
cards.subtitle: Tree Lighting & Carnival
cards.notes: Gather on the Hagan Lawn for the annual Christmas tree lighting ceremony and a winter carnival featuring seasonal treats and holiday music.
cards.short_summary: The university's official holiday kickoff event featuring a tree lighting and outdoor carnival.
cards.evidence_claim: Winterfest and the Christmas Tree Lighting ceremony are held annually on the Hagan Lawn at the end of the fall semester.
cards.access_notes: Held on the lawn in front of the Hagan Campus Center in early December.

boards.title: Your First Weekend at Assumption University, Shared as Cards
boards.description: Build a plausible under-21-safe first-weekend sequence, not a ranking. Give each card one role in the sequence and use evergreen places or recurring behaviors rather than one-time events. Be conservative about hours, access, and travel time unless directly sourced.

cards.title: Arrive for First-Year Check-In
cards.subtitle: Friday Morning Arrival
cards.notes: Drive through the main gates on Salisbury Street to begin your move-in process. Faculty and student leaders wait here to welcome the new class to Hound Nation.
cards.short_summary: The official start of move-in weekend for incoming first-year students.
cards.evidence_claim: First-Year Student Check-In Day is the official beginning for new students, with the community welcoming them at the Salisbury Street campus.
cards.source_title: First-Year Student Check-In Day - Assumption University
cards.access_notes: Check-in typically begins in the morning; specific time slots are assigned via the student portal.

cards.title: Refuel at Taylor Dining Hall
cards.subtitle: Friday Midday Meal
cards.notes: Visit the newly renovated dining hall for an all-you-care-to-enjoy lunch. It features 12 food concepts and a fireplace for a relaxed first meal on campus.
cards.short_summary: The primary resident dining facility on campus, recently renovated with diverse food stations.
cards.evidence_claim: Taylor Dining Hall is the primary dining venue, offering 12 concepts and continuous dining hours during the week.
cards.access_notes: Open 7:45 AM to 8:00 PM Monday-Thursday, closing at 7:00 PM on Fridays.

cards.title: Walk by the Duck Pond
cards.subtitle: Friday Afternoon Stroll
cards.notes: Located near the main entrance, this pond is a central campus landmark. It is a quiet spot to sit and observe the resident ducks during the warmer months.
cards.short_summary: A scenic campus landmark and popular student gathering spot near La Maison Francaise.
cards.evidence_claim: The duck pond is one of the first things seen when entering campus and is a popular place for students to relax and study.
cards.source_title: Take a virtual campus tour and explore Assumption University - YouTube
cards.access_notes: Outdoor public space accessible at all times.

cards.title: Explore the Student Hub
cards.subtitle: Friday Evening Social
cards.notes: Head to Hagan to find the bookstore, student organization offices, and Charlie's Snack Bar. It serves as the main activity hub for the community.
cards.short_summary: The central hub for student activities, organizations, and retail dining.
cards.evidence_claim: Hagan Campus Center serves as an activity hub, housing Charlie's Snack Bar, the bookstore, and student organizations.
cards.access_notes: Charlie's Snack Bar inside is open until midnight Monday through Friday.

cards.title: Visit the Plourde Rec Center
cards.subtitle: Saturday Morning Fitness
cards.notes: Start your Saturday with a workout or a swim. The facility includes a fitness center, indoor pool, racquetball courts, and three basketball courts.
cards.short_summary: The university's main fitness and recreation facility for students.
cards.evidence_claim: The Plourde Recreation Center offers fitness equipment, an indoor pool, and courts for various sports.
cards.access_notes: Open Saturday from 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM; student ID required for entry.

cards.title: Grab Lunch at Charlie's
cards.subtitle: Saturday Midday Bite
cards.notes: Located in the Hagan Campus Center, Charlie's offers made-to-order and grab-and-go meals. It is a popular alternative to the main dining hall.
cards.short_summary: A retail dining location offering quick meals and a social atmosphere.
cards.evidence_claim: Charlie's Snack Bar is a retail operation in the Hagan Campus Center offering a variety of meals.
cards.access_notes: Open 11:00 AM to midnight Monday-Friday; weekend hours vary by event schedule.

cards.title: Find a Study Spot
cards.subtitle: Saturday Afternoon Prep
cards.notes: Locate your favorite study nook among the library's various spaces. It offers group study rooms and research guidance from professional staff.
cards.short_summary: The main academic library providing research resources and diverse study environments.
cards.evidence_claim: The Emmanuel d'Alzon Library offers a variety of study spaces, including group study rooms.
cards.access_notes: Weekend hours are typically 1:00 PM to 9:00 PM on Sundays; Saturday hours vary by semester.

cards.title: Cheer at the Stadium
cards.subtitle: Saturday Night Spirit
cards.notes: Join the Hound Pound in the stands for a home game. This multi-sport stadium features a turf field and is the center of Greyhound athletic pride.
cards.short_summary: The home field for Assumption football, lacrosse, and field hockey.
cards.evidence_claim: Brian Kelly '83 Stadium is the home for Greyhounds football and other multi-sport events.
cards.access_notes: Access is generally restricted to scheduled athletic events and games.

cards.title: Attend Sunday Mass
cards.subtitle: Sunday Morning Reflection
cards.notes: Participate in a community liturgy at the campus chapel. It is a central location for spiritual life and the site of many university traditions.
cards.short_summary: The primary place of worship on campus, hosting regular Catholic Masses.
cards.evidence_claim: The Chapel of the Holy Spirit hosts regular Masses, including special community celebrations like the Mass of the Holy Spirit.
cards.source_title: Prayer and Worship on Campus - Assumption University
cards.access_notes: Sunday Masses are typically held at 10:00 AM and 7:00 PM during the academic year.

cards.title: Join a Post-Mass Social
cards.subtitle: Sunday Evening Connection
cards.notes: After the 7 PM Mass, head to the Lauring Community Room for light refreshments and conversation. It's a great way to meet peers before the week starts.
cards.short_summary: A community space for spiritual formation, reflection, and social gatherings.
cards.evidence_claim: The Tinsley Campus Ministry Center hosts receptions after the 10 AM and 7 PM Sunday Masses in the Lauring Community Room.
cards.source_title: Campus Ministry – Weekly Newsletter - The Assumptionists
cards.access_notes: The center is open 6:00 AM to 11:00 PM daily for prayer and reflection.
